warnings: เหล็กเสริมข้ออ้อยทั้งหมด ให้ใช้ชั้นคุณภาพ SD 40 (กรอบหมายเหตุมุมล่างซ้ายของแผ่น)

Each beam is drawn as an elevation with numbered cuts; every cut is one entry with its section_ref (the same mark repeated is the same member, not a collision). Bars that the elevation shows as extra (curtailed) top or bottom bars are summed into that face's count with the split kept in printed_as/note (spec section 7 merge rule).
G10 (grid 1/17, A-C 8.00) + G10/1 (C-D 2.50) are drawn as one continuous elevation over the column at C; G11 (10.50) has support zones of 2.60 with DB25 top bars and ø9@0.10 ties.

Hand corrections: G10's top count '3' and several stirrup spacings are re-inked bold; G11 cut 1-1 prints its spacing with a re-inked digit that can be read 0.40 or 0.10 — the elevation's boxed label for that zone reads 'ป-ø9mm.@ 0.10m.', so 0.10 is taken (flagged).
